title: The pup at the step, the first time
logline: The garage step in January and the pup, eleven, stopping at it for the first time before going up, a beat, then up. A hand not in the frame. The 2027 page's first draft, a year early.

panels.composition: An old three-legged dog paused before a single concrete step at a garage door in January, its weight back, the door's window lit.
